channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Announcing Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway – expanding access to Cloudflare’s privacy-preserving infrastructure
item.description: We’re announcing the closed beta of a self-serve Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway. We’re also renaming our Privacy Gateway to Cloudflare OHTTP Relay to better distinguish the two products. (2 sources: cloudflare, lobsters)

item.title: Presentation: Building GenAI Platform at DoorDash
item.description: Swaroop Chitlur and Sidd Kodwani share DoorDash’s journey building an internal GenAI platform. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Istio 1.31 Adds Agentgateway Waypoints and Moves Release Artifacts off Google Cloud
item.description: Istio 1.31 adds agentgateway waypoints in ambient mode, with a canary configuration fix included in 1.31.1. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers
item.description: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
item.description: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability
item.description: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
item.description: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
item.description: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Go JSON v2 Migration: What Breaks in Go 1.27
item.description: Go 1.27 ships encoding/json/v2. We ran v1 and v2 side by side on the same structs: here is every output that changed and the option or tag that fixes it. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: AI is changing developer work. Here are three skills to strengthen.
item.description: Learn to direct AI agents, critically review their output, and keep technical judgment at the center of your workflow. The post AI is changing developer work. Here are three skills to strengthen. appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Lobsters Interview with Sjamaan
item.description: Our dear @sjamaan ( website ) is a CHICKEN scheme maintainer and professional Clojure developer. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Uber Eats Rebuilds Search Pipeline to Cut End-to-End Latency by 50%
item.description: Uber has rebuilt major parts of the Uber Eats search pipeline, reporting a 50% reduction in end-to-end latency. (1 source: infoq)
